snippet.title: Bouncy for the TI-99/4A
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

A homebrew platforming game similar to Bounder. The player has to get to the chequered platform, avoiding enemies, falling off the platforms, collecting rings (not necessary but gives points) and jumping/rolling on platforms with a ? on it (also not necessary but gives random bonuses - some good, some bad).
